page.title: Data retention
page.description: Every kind of data the platform deletes on a schedule, in one table. For each, set how many days it stays in the database and, where it can be archived, how many more days the archive keeps it before it is deleted for good. Nothing changes for an item until you save values for it.
page.superOnly: Only a super admin can change retention. You can see the saved values and what the last run did.

engine.offTitle: The archive job is switched off
engine.offBody: Values saved for the analytics events and the audit log are stored, but nothing is archived to S3 / R2 or dropped until the job is enabled (RETENTION_ENABLED). Until then both keep their current behaviour. Every other item below is carried out by its own nightly job and is not affected.
engine.dryRunTitle: The archive job only logs what it would do
engine.dryRunBody: It is on but in dry-run mode (RETENTION_DRY_RUN). Saved values for the analytics events and the audit log are not carried out yet. Every other item below is unaffected.
engine.notDurableBody: The archive is a folder on the server's own disk, which a redeploy erases. The job refuses to drop any data until it points at S3 or R2 (ARCHIVE_DRIVER=s3).
engine.liveBody: Saved values for the analytics events and the audit log are carried out by the nightly run. Their archive is kept in {driver}. Every other item is carried out by its own nightly job.

an_events.title: Analytics events
an_events.description: The event stream behind the reports. Whole months move to the archive once they are older than the live days.

audit_log.title: Audit log
audit_log.description: Who did what in each workspace, including actions taken while acting as a user. Until you save values it is deleted after the platform security policy's days and never archived. Saved values archive first and delete later, and exports can still read archived months.

security_events.title: Security log
security_events.description: Sign-ins, security changes and every retention change made here. It is deleted after the live days and has no archive.

audit_log_exports.title: Audit export files
audit_log_exports.description: The CSV a workspace requests from its audit log. The requester gets an email with a link to sign in and download it; the file is deleted after the live days.

message_log.title: Message delivery log
message_log.description: The delivery log of each message: sent, delivered, failed, retried. Events leave the live table after the live days and move, compressed, into the archive; archive days then count from that day. The log of a message, and the log exports, can still read the archive.

notifications_read.title: Notifications (read)
notifications_read.description: Bell notifications a user has already read. They are deleted once they are this many days old. The built-in number comes from the server settings (NOTIFY_RETENTION_READ_DAYS).

notifications_unread.title: Notifications (never read)
notifications_unread.description: Bell notifications nobody opened. They are deleted once they are this many days old, and never before the read ones (the save is refused if it would be). The built-in number comes from the server settings (NOTIFY_RETENTION_UNREAD_DAYS).

push_devices_revoked.title: Revoked push devices
push_devices_revoked.description: Browsers and phones that stopped accepting push notifications. Kept briefly so a device that comes back can switch notifications on again, then deleted.

assignment_runs.title: Assignment run log
assignment_runs.description: The record of each automatic contact assignment run, with who got what and why. Deleted after the live days.

form_events.title: Form analytics events
form_events.description: Views, starts and submits of the web forms, used for the form conversion charts. They hold no answers. Deleted after the live days. The answers themselves follow each form's own retention.

lead_sync_runs.title: Lead sync runs
lead_sync_runs.description: The record of each lead sync or backfill from an ad platform: who pulled what and when. Deleted after the live days. The raw lead payloads follow each source's own retention.

lead_scoring_runs.title: AI lead scoring log
lead_scoring_runs.description: Each AI lead score with its reasons, and the conversation readings and stage suggestions behind it. Until you save a value here, the number set in the AI lead scoring settings is used. A person under a legal hold keeps their records.

api_library_logs.title: API Library run log
api_library_logs.description: The request and response log of each API Library call. Deleted after the live days.

flow_run_logs.title: Automation run log
flow_run_logs.description: Each finished run of an automation flow with its steps, and flow versions no run points at any more. Runs still in progress are never touched.

webhook_forward_failures.title: Failed webhook deliveries
webhook_forward_failures.description: Webhook deliveries that failed and can still be replayed. After the live days they can no longer be replayed and are deleted.

click_calls.title: Unreported click-to-call placements
click_calls.description: A click-to-call whose finished call never came back from the provider. Forgotten after the live days.

call_recordings.title: Call recordings
call_recordings.description: The default number of days a call recording is kept, for workspaces that never chose their own window; a workspace's own window still wins. After it the recording file is deleted and the call stays. A recording under a legal hold is kept.

fields.liveDaysHint: Days the data stays in the database. Allowed: {min} to {max}.
fields.archiveDaysHint: Further days the archive keeps it, then it is deleted. Allowed: {min} to {max}.

summary.noArchive: Deleted for good {live, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after it is written.
summary.archiveForever: Kept live for {live, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, then archived and kept for ever.
summary.archiveThenDelete: Kept live for {live, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, archived for {archive, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, then deleted for good {total, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after it is written.
summary.defaultForever: Currently kept for ever (the security policy has no limit).

actions.resetBody: The saved values are removed. The nightly jobs go back to the built-in rules for this item. Data already archived stays in the archive.

preview.title: Save retention for {item}?
preview.toArchive: {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} ({rows} rows, {size}) will move to the archive and leave the database.
preview.toDeleteFromArchive: {count, plural, one {# archived month} other {# archived months}} will be deleted from the archive for good.
preview.rowsToDelete: {count, plural, one {# row or file} other {# rows or files}} will be deleted for good.
preview.notApplied: The archive job is not carrying out saved values yet, so none of this happens until it is enabled.
preview.permanent: Deleting is permanent and cannot be undone.
preview.rowsToArchive: {count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} will move from the live table into the archive.

validation.live_out_of_range: Live days must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
validation.archive_out_of_range: Archive days must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
validation.delete_before_archive: The data cannot be deleted before it is archived.
validation.not_a_number: Enter a whole number of days.
validation.unread_before_read: Unread notifications cannot be deleted before read ones. Set the unread days to at least the read days.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this item. The latest values have been loaded; check them and save again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.
